title: RoofSeg: An edge-aware transformer-based network for end-to-end roof plane segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2508.19003v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Roof plane segmentation is one of the key procedures for reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) building models at levels of detail (LoD) 2 and 3 from airborne light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds. The majority of current approaches for roof plane segmentation rely on the manually designed or learned features followed by some specifically designed geometric clustering strategies. Because the learned features are more powerful than the manually designed features, the deep learning-based approaches usually perform better than the traditional approaches. However, the current deep learning-based approaches have three unsolved problems. The first is that most of them are not truly end-to-end, the plane segmentation results may be not optimal. translated_title: RoofSeg：一种用于端到端屋顶平面分割的边缘感知Transformer网络
translated_abstract: 屋顶平面分割是从机载激光雷达点云重建细节层次LoD2和LoD3三维建筑模型的关键步骤之一。目前大多数屋顶平面分割方法依赖于人工设计或学习到的特征，之后再采用一些专门设计的几何聚类策略。由于学习到的特征比人工设计的特征更强大，基于深度学习的方法通常比传统方法表现更好。然而，目前基于深度学习的方法存在三个尚未解决的问题。第一个问题是大多数方法并非真正的端到端，平面分割结果可能不是最优的。第二个问题是边缘附近点的特征区分度相对较低，导致平面边缘不够精确。第三个问题是平面几何特征……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了RoofSeg，一种边缘感知的Transformer网络，实现了从机载LiDAR点云中进行真正端到端的屋顶平面分割，解决了现有深度学习方法非端到端、边缘附近特征区分度低等问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RoofSeg, an edge-aware transformer-based network that achieves truly end-to-end roof plane segmentation from airborne LiDAR point clouds, addressing the unsolved problems of non-end-to-end pipelines and low point feature discriminability near edges in existing deep learning approaches.
